For example, if it takes 500 damage specifically to that tower, and one beginner has dealt 400 damage, the seasoned player behind him cannot steal the tower and still has to fully deal 500 damage, even if he/she kills the beginner, as only that beginner can simply deal 100 more damage to finish the job because the beginner has already dealt the 400 damage previously. This means there cannot be any assists or capture steals as the amount of damage that each player has to deal on a tower will vary.

WAR

Also, more gamemodes may be handy, but we need to improve on the map editor for custom gamemodes.

We need trigger editing.

Like traps, what if we can edit it so we can go into a 'effect' editor to put 'sensors' that activates when the player interacts with it?

Falling rocks and spike traps for instance. We can make the fire effect to be able to inflict fire damage.

Lets improve on the current map editing function for now:

DM - Being able to rotate the block, and changing it so you can have a arrow so you know which way the player will spawn.
Being able to change the invincibility time for the DM mode for players can help. Set it to be a slider between 3~10 seconds of invincibility, and a checkbox to whether you lose invincibility prematurely if you shoot or not.

TDM - Same as above, with additional changes. Remove the 8 flag limit, and change it to a 'max' spawn points. So you have to have a minimum of 1 flag. The players will spawn on the same block, since players can clip through each other until they leave the collision. Add a feature to decide how players can spawn through multiple spawn points. Add a 'enable/disable' flag on each spawn point so players can do some sort of objective to activite or deactivate the spawn point (so outposts). This is to have outposts and gamemodes that allows players to capture bases.

CTF - Add extra functionality so CTF can function with 1 'capture point' on each team's designated point. To allow you to capture the other team's flag and bring it back like the old CTF style. Allow configuration so the game doesn't end once a point is captured so you don't freeze up and respawn.

Add 'enable respawns' checkboxes for DM and TDM gamemodes so you can change them into DM Elimination and TDM elimination modes.

Finally, for games with rounds or round based gamemodes, add a 'block respawn between rounds' checkbox so blocks like crates and glass can respawn if a round ends.

Users Safety Suggestion: Report User Profile
Idea founded, written, and displayed independently by:
Nicholas P******(asterisks for privacy)

Adding to the security and the well-being of the Brick-Force Forums and community, we all love to be safe right? I can see that there is currently only one thing to report that has been created by a user, and that is their posts and/or threads in the forums. If you click someone's profile, you will notice that there are many fields of text and content in which inappropriate material can be withheld. In an effort to fight this problem, I am proposing that Brick-Force should implement a "Report User" function into anyone's given profile page. This will allow users to submit reports on profiles and diminish most, if not all, profanity and/or unsafe content from the Brick-Force Forums. Seeing how this is implemented on many other forum sites to keep their sites free of profane material, Brick-Force should work towards a safer and parent-approved environment here at Brick-Force Forums. To go into greater detail about how this function would work is that there would be an icon with the words "Report User Profile" somewhere located on all profile pages. This would bring up a page (or a lightbox for convenience of the user and to add efficiency to the site) that would allow a user to submit information in a HTML Textarea element (Did I forget to mention I am a web designer?). Through this process, a Moderator would review the report on the profile and use his/her discretion to take the appropriate actions regarding the reported user's profile and/or account status. To conclude my suggestion, I know that this feature would just give a little more of a safety cushion around the idea of Brick-Force Forums, for parents and children alike. I believe the goal for Brick-Force Forums is to make it a safe, yet fun environment. Kids will love it, parents will trust it. Brick-Force Forums.
Message to all readers!
If you've gotten to this point in the thread, that means you either skipped to the red text because you feel like it isn't important to read someone's thread that is "too long", or you actually read the whole thing. If you have read the whole suggestion, thank you and keep in mind, your feedback is greatly appreciated (good or bad, I want to know what you think). If you haven't I advise you, I implore you, please read the entire thread and then provide feedback.

If you would like to contact me, please either use the link in my signature (PM me) or send a message via Skype (link to the left under my avatar). If you would like to provide feedback or contact me in a public environment, feel free to post a reply in this thread. Thank you all for taking your time out of your day to discover this thread, and have a great day.

I'm usually unbiased, as I am with this suggestion. But let me add some feedback as to how this could truly be done (and negate the previous concerns)

Now I'm not too involved in most FPS games but I've seen online split screen done before -as well as on other genres of commercially available AAA games-

Farming and lack of multiple mouse and keyboards would definitely be true in the way you pitched the idea, so here's how it could realistically be implemented.

Don't use multiple accounts, use a "guest profile" which in this case would be perfectly fine. Probably lock them to the same team to further prevent farming. Then to dodge the hardware dilemma, we'd have to have gamepad support, but this would also allow us to have more players at once anyway.

Now whether this is something we'll ever see in B-F or not I don't know but I will say adding gamepad support is a risky thing to do on MMOs as it can open up a pretty big exploit if not implemented right.
